Returns policy
returns-v1 / EN / DEMO
FICTIONAL STORE - TEACHING EXAMPLE ONLY
Effective / Vigencia: [2026-01-01, 2026-07-01)
Date basis / Fecha base: purchase_date
Uploaded / Carga: 2026-01-02  |  Status / Estado: READY
1. Applicability: This version applies to DEMO-market orders purchased on or after 2026-01-01
and before 2026-07-01. The purchase date selects the policy; the upload date does not.
2. Return window: A return can be requested within 30 calendar days after purchase. Eligibility
also requires an unused item, original packaging, and proof of purchase. A chatbot may explain
the policy but cannot approve a return.
3. Historical validity: A later policy does not replace these terms for purchases in this interval.
Missing order dates or conflicting policy records require clarification or support review.

Política de devoluciones
returns-v1 / ES / DEMO
TIENDA FICTICIA - SOLO EJEMPLO EDUCATIVO
Effective / Vigencia: [2026-01-01, 2026-07-01)
Date basis / Fecha base: purchase_date
Uploaded / Carga: 2026-01-02  |  Status / Estado: READY
1. Aplicación: Esta versión aplica a pedidos del mercado DEMO comprados desde 2026-01-01
y antes de 2026-07-01. La fecha de compra selecciona la política; la fecha de carga no.
2. Plazo de devolución: Puede solicitarse una devolución dentro de 30 días calendario desde la
compra. También se requiere un artículo sin usar, empaque original y comprobante de compra.
El chatbot explica la política, pero no aprueba devoluciones.
3. Validez histórica: Una política posterior no reemplaza estos términos para compras de este
intervalo. Si faltan fechas o existen registros contradictorios, debe aclararse el caso o escalarlo
a soporte.

Refunds policy
refunds-v1 / EN / DEMO
FICTIONAL STORE - TEACHING EXAMPLE ONLY
Effective / Vigencia: [2026-01-01, open-ended)
Date basis / Fecha base: approval_date
Uploaded / Carga: 2026-01-02  |  Status / Estado: READY
1. Applicability: This version applies to DEMO-market refunds approved on or after 2026-01-01.
The verified refund approval date selects the policy, not the purchase date or the date of the
question.
2. Refund timing: After approval, refunds normally appear on the original payment method
within 5 to 7 business days. This is an expected processing window, not confirmation that a
particular refund was sent or completed.
3. Transaction status: Actual approval and payment status must come from an authenticated
order or payment API. PDF retrieval cannot issue money, confirm a transfer, or bypass account
verification.

Date basis / Fecha base: approval_date

1. Aplicación: Esta versión aplica a reembolsos del mercado DEMO aprobados desde
2026-01-01. La fecha verificada de aprobación selecciona la política, no la fecha de compra ni
la de consulta.
2. Plazo del reembolso: Después de la aprobación, el reembolso normalmente aparece en el
medio de pago original dentro de 5 a 7 días hábiles. Es un plazo esperado, no una
confirmación de que un reembolso específico fue enviado o completado.
3. Estado transaccional: La aprobación y el estado del pago deben consultarse en una API
autenticada de pedidos o pagos. El retrieval del PDF no emite dinero, confirma transferencias
ni omite verificación de la cuenta.

Privacy policy
privacy-v1 / EN / DEMO
FICTIONAL STORE - TEACHING EXAMPLE ONLY
Effective / Vigencia: [2026-01-01, open-ended)
Date basis / Fecha base: question_date
Uploaded / Carga: 2026-01-02  |  Status / Estado: READY
1. Applicability: For questions about current DEMO-market store practices, use the policy
effective on the question date. Questions about historical practices require the relevant event
date and support review when the scope is unclear.
2. Data handling: The fictional store uses name, email, shipping address, and payment
reference to fulfill orders and provide support. Its demo policy retains order records for 12
months after purchase and does not store full payment-card numbers.
3. Customer requests: Account access and deletion requests require identity verification and a
separate authorized workflow. The chatbot may explain the policy, but it cannot claim that it
accessed or deleted personal data.
